Name: Renamed Dwarves
Author: sqbr
Description:
Because they're not dwarves, they're aliens! Also, my understanding is that real life people with dwarfism don't like the way the term is used for fantasy creatures, so here's a way to avoid it.

This mod is compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13434]Gender Setter[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9271]Ultimate Villager Manager[/url]  but will overwrite the settings for the Dwarf's name and birthday (noone ever actually refers to the Dwarf's gender so those settings are irrelevant)[b]

[/b]It overwrites most dialogue involving Dwarf and all 'dwarven' items and monsters. It does not affect any images.
[b]
Customisation:[/b]
Either edit config.json or use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
DwarfName: The name of the NPC Dwarf.
DwarfPeople: The species Dwarf is a part of. Should start with a capital letter.
dwarves: Plural form for a group of members of this species.
dwarven: Adjective describing things connected to the species, as well as the language.

[b]Credits:[/b]

Some code is taken from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9271]Ultimate Villager Manager[/url].
